text:
Maya R: Quick sync on APAC pilot retention & compliance launch gates. We need explicit PRD language for SOC2 + ISO auditors. Primary questions: regional retention parity, legal-hold behavior, and how we describe long-term proof storage to customers.
Ina (Legal): For ISO/SOC2 evidence around controls, auditors expect demonstrable chain-of-custody. Region doesn't change the expectation much; documenting retention policy + how evidence is preserved (signed bundles, timestamps, access logs) is key.
Jordan P: Suggestion: For pilot: operational logs = 3 years (auto-tier/archival); signed crypto proofs & keystore attestations = 7 years immutable. Provide enterprise upgrade to custom retention.
Samir: Implementation pattern that works: hot -> warm (90d) -> cold (1y) -> immutable archive (7y). Cost estimate: +12% storage cost vs 3y-only. Need an export path for immutable proofs before any deletion.
Kevin: Ops reality: our KMS/HSM vendor only exports proofs in batched signed bundles today. We need a small export daemon + verifier that stamps bundle with our custody signature. Rough build: 4 dev-days + 2 QA + 1 ops doc day.
Nadia (Solutions): Customer-facing ask: emphasize "signed evidence bundles retained for 7 years" and that "operational logs are tiered after 90 days; default 3-year window." Also call out legal-hold.
Maya R: Good. Two tricky items: 1) should legal-hold be region-scoped? 2) How do we phrase "immutable" without promising impossible guarantees?
Ina (Legal): Legal-hold should be global to simplify audits; we can allow region filter in UI but hold applies across storage tiers. For "immutable" use: "retained in a tamper-evident archived bundle" and surface export checksum + signature for customers.
Jordan P: Draft artifact mapping (quick):
```
artifact                 pilot-retention      customer-visible-label
operational-stream_logs  3y (auto-tier)      "Default: 3 years, tiered"
keystore-attestations    7y (archived)        "Signed key proofs: 7 years"
evidence-bundles         7y (immutable-archive) "Tamper-evident evidence bundles: 7 years"
access-audit-events      3y                   "Access logs: 3 years"
kms-meta                 7y                   "KMS metadata/proofs: 7 years"
```
Samir: Add runbook note: retention-service exposes `legal_hold=true` flag that prevents tiering/purge. Add manual override workflow for compliance team with audit trail.
Kevin: Estimate to add legal-hold flag end-to-end: 6 dev-days (service + UI + infra) + 3 test days. We'll prototype minimal API first.
Maya R: Launch criteria (proposed):
- PRD updated with artifact mapping and customer-facing copy
- Legal confirms auditor-friendly language + chain-of-custody statement
- Retention-service supports legal-hold flag in staging and can freeze export
- Export pipeline for keystore proofs created and signed bundles validated by ops
- Cost delta estimate and opt-in enterprise contract language ready
Nadia (Solutions): Also need sample contract clause and admin UI mock for legal-hold; I'll draft.
Ina (Legal): I can sign off on language once we include: signature algorithm, timestamp source, custody stamp, and process for responding to auditor requests.
Maya R: Action items:
- Jordan: Update PRD + drafting customer copy (owner) -> due Wed EOD
- Kevin + Samir: Spike export daemon & legal-hold flag in staging (owner) -> spike complete in 7 calendar days
- Nadia: sample contract clause + admin UI mock (owner) -> draft by next Tues
- Ina: confirm auditor language after PRD update (owner) -> response within 3 business days
ops-bot: snapshot retention-proto created for env=staging at 2026-03-20T09:12:05Z
Jordan P: I'll push PRD update today. Will include suggested doc phrasing per Nadia.
Samir: Will start runbook and cost calc; will note vault export cadence.
Kevin: Noted, will begin prototype and log estimates in the ticket.
Maya R: Tentative decision: Proceed with APAC pilot using: operational logs default 3y (tiered), cryptographic proofs 7y in tamper-evident archive, legal-hold global freeze, enterprise options for custom retention. Final signoff pending Ina's auditor language.
Nadia (Solutions): Customer copy suggestion: "Default data retention: operational logs retained for 3 years (automatically tiered). Cryptographic proofs and keystore attestations are retained in tamper-evident bundles for 7 years. Legal hold and enterprise retention available upon request."
Ina (Legal): That copy is acceptable with the addition: "Customers may request extended retention under an enterprise agreement."
Maya R: Thanks all. Closing loop: Jordan will post PRD link here when done and we'll move to sprint triage.
